notes: `שְׁאֵלָה` is written in the Hebrew, so *make* stays with the verb rather than being the light verb of a complement the ASV supplied (rule 44).
The verbless possessive clause puts *had* on the `לְ` and the subject pronoun on its suffix (rule 43); the waw whose clause the ASV subordinates takes the *that* (rules 14, 55).
